text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt satisfying, but a gain versus my cost basis alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider the position’s role in my portfolio.","I should not hold a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake; my purchase price is in the past, and I should reassess it on its merits.","With prices moving randomly and no need to trade every month, I should avoid reading trends into short-term changes and trade only when my goals or risk needs call for it."]}
